In the headlines: “GIFT Nifty jumps over 1 pc on easing oil prices, signals strong start for Indian markets” (IANS LIVE). “Seoul shares soar over 4 pc to snap 3-day slide on tech rally, oil prices fall” (The Hawk).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 12.1% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 93.92 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
